scope: ADR 0089 intermediate any/all builtin acceptance; not the final language benchmark
limitations: uncontrolled desktop load and CPU frequency
no CPU affinity or hardware performance counters
no per-workload RSS or host allocator counters
the warm comparison intentionally measures Tonic's interpreter path; JIT is not enabled
warm Tonic uses a fresh VM outside the timer; both engines execute into a fresh module namespace
results apply only to the listed shared-syntax any/all workload
